name: device-login-answer-refused

graded_by.test: core/internal/ws/device_login_test.go — TestAStaleWrongCountOrLongAnswerIsRequestRefusedAndNothingCrossesC3: each refusal comes back as request_refused and nothing crosses C3, with a good answer crossing in the same test as the positive control

description: A device-login answer the core will not relay is answered, never dropped silently. `request_refused` with `request: device_login_answer` and reason `not_pending` (another prompt_id, or none outstanding) or `invalid` (a wrong count of strings, or a string past 1024 bytes of UTF-8); the same request with `device_login_hostkey_answer` and `not_pending` when no key question is outstanding. Either way the prompt stays outstanding and nothing crosses C3. The core checks before it relays, so a refused answer never reaches the worker.

instances.note: a wrong count of strings, or an over-long one
an answer to a key question nobody asked
only a client request is refused
